events.title: We are live at Steam Next Fest!
events.summary: Hey everyone!We’re excited to share that Exit Club: Last Night Again is participating in Steam Next Fest!If you haven't tried our demo yet, now is the perfect time to jump in and experience it!Wishlist: Don't forget to hit that Wishlist button if you enjoy the experience—it really helps us out!Thank you for all the support, and enjoy Next Fest!

events.title: We finally finished the trailer for Exit Club: Last Night Again!
events.summary: Hey everyone,Just dropped the trailer for Exit Club: Last Night Again.Let us know your thoughts!

events.title: Exit Club: Last Night Again Demo Is Live!
events.summary: Our new game Exit Club: Last Night Again now has a demo on Steam.You go to a nightclub expecting a normal night, but soon realize that the same night keeps repeating.Talk to different people, try different choices, learn something new each loop, and unlock new dialogue options as you slowly figure out what’s happening.It’s a dialogue-heavy game with branching choices, different characters, and a mystery that unfolds as you replay the night.The demo is available now, and you can wishlist the game

events.title: New Screenshots & Demo Coming Soon
events.summary: Hey everyone!We’ve added some new in-game screenshots and a new GIF to the store page to give you a better look at Exit Club: Last Night Again.We’re still working on the game and polishing things up, but the demo should be ready within the next week.Thanks for following the development and supporting us!

events.title: Exit Club: Last Night Again — Demo coming within a month!
events.summary: We’re still working hard on Exit Club: Last Night Again, and the demo is getting closer.The game takes place during a night that keeps repeating itself over and over again.We’re planning to release the demo within a month, so follow the game and stay tuned for more updates.

events.title: Exit Club: Last Night Again
events.summary: We're excited to reveal our adult visual novel project: Exit Club: Last Night Again.In this mystery-driven visual novel, you'll find yourself trapped in a nightclub where the same night repeats over and over again.
